summary: Provision timeboxed anonymized keyed-response mapping for legal eDiscovery request
description:
Issue summary:
Request from Legal for a narrow, timeboxed extract that maps anonymized response hashes back to ephemeral request identifiers to support an eDiscovery demand. The extract must not include raw customer payloads and must follow our redaction/aggregation controls.

Impact:
- Legal needs mapping for three subpoenas to validate response provenance.
- Customer data must remain protected; extraction must be minimized and reversible only within a secure enclave for the legal team.
- High urgency due to 7-day statutory response window.

Environment:
- Production inference traces in us-west and EU-CENTRAL for the affected customers.
- Data flows touch serving-runtime, tokenization, and the session KV cache.

Request details / Acceptance criteria:
- Provide a timeboxed artifact that contains: anonymized_response_hash -> ephemeral_request_id (internal id), timestamp, model_version, region. No full prompts, no full outputs.
- Apply deterministic salt per-legal-request stored in HSM, record KMS envelope IDs.
- Redaction verification: automated scan to ensure no PII patterns leaked; attach verification report.
- Data access window: 72 hours after approval to export; artifacts to be stored in secure S3 path with restricted ACLs and audit logging.

Steps to reproduce / gather:
1) Legal attached subpoenas (see comment) and specified scope.
2) Privacy asked for minimal mapping; SRE to produce sample for verification.
3) Need formal privacy sign-off and infra gating (temporary role-based access).

Logs / artifacts available:
- SRE trace slice: s3://redwood-prod-traces/edr/2026-03-05/slice-11.jsonl
- Dashboard snapshot: https://observability.redwood.ai/dashboards/edr-384217

Approvals required:
- Privacy (Data Protection Officer)
- Security (temporary access and HSM use)
- Legal (requestor confirmation of scope)

Requested by: Legal - Samir Patel (internal counsel)
Urgency: statutory (7 days)
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10: Initial triage by Support. Confirmed subpoenas and scope with Legal via #legal-requests slack thread.
2026-03-10: SRE sampled a 1000-request slice and validated that response hashes can be generated deterministically using sha256 with a per-request salt; placed sample in secure staging bucket.
2026-03-11: Privacy reviewed sample, flagged two edge cases where low-entropy outputs could risk re-identification; recommended bucketization and suppression for outputs under token-length threshold.
2026-03-11: Security requested KMS envelope approach; will generate ephemeral key scoped to this request and log envelope ID in audit trail.
2026-03-12: Created runbook draft for the export process and RBAC steps; awaiting DPO signature. Runbook location attached in related_confluence_pages.

Hypotheses:\n- Hypothesis A: A deterministic hash + per-request salt is sufficient if outputs below N tokens are suppressed.\n- Hypothesis B: Additional noise/aggregation may be required for small outputs to avoid re-identification.
